body:
**[comments] Rule 4, comment lines that map to no code line: move**

The comment explains `positions(page_t::page_size + 1)` (3744) and why token positions are set at all, but it sits above `pages{page}` (3742), which it does not describe. Move the two lines down to directly above the positions vector.

Proposed:
```cpp
  // The page's tokens plus the query token (position page_size), as the
  // sliding-window check reads token positions.
```
